headline: SSX's Salis grab finally grips the board
lede: The mirrored cross-grab had hovered 0.41 m off the nose edge through three IK passes. The real bug was coordinate space: the arm solver mixed board-space targets with world-space bones 100 m down the mountain, collapsing the elbow fold to nothing.

notes.text: Salis reach 0.41 -> 0.125 m; Indy and Method tightened too (0.068 / 0.033). All five named-grab reach gates are green live.
Impossible magnitudes are the clue: a debug probe showing a 0.2 m forearm spanning 122.9 m named the bug in one run — roll-space points were being fed into parent worldToLocal without roll->world.
Honest gaps #0 (boots + hands on the board) is now closed whole: weld #883, hand IK #967, spine flex #971, Salis #980.
A tuning knob (deeper scapula slide) was built, measured unnecessary after the real fix, and deleted before shipping.
